 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The difference between a disaster of a season and an "okay, we'll get 'em next year" season? Winning an SEC game.
 Vanderbilt heads to Starkville, Mississippi, this afternoon in an attempt to make it the latter. (The last three games of the season: Alabama, at Florida, Tennessee. So, yeah, probably the last chance we'll realistically have.) Mississippi State is 2-4 in the SEC, but has failed to score a touchdown in two of their last three games, and thanks to an injury to September Heisman winner Kamario Taylor, they're playing our old friend AJ Swann at quarterback.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement I'll probably be mostly out of commission for this game thanks to my daughters having their sixth birthday party this afternoon. That's right: the day they were born, we were also playing a game at Mississippi State. And also, there was a campaign press conference at Four Seasons Total Landscaping in Philly. Anchor Down.
